newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangdong Brewery offers 350 mln shrs in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Brewery offers 350 mln shrs in IPO.

text.p: Guangdong Brewery Holdings Ltd, a unit of Guangdong Investment Ltd, said on Monday it is issuing 350 million shares at HK$1.80 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.
The issue price represents a prospective price to earnings multiple of 20.9 times on a proforma fully-diluted basis, and 20.9 times on a weighted-average basis.
The prospective dividend yield is 1.7 percent. The adjusted net asset value per share is HK$1.05.
The IPO will run from July 29 to August 1 and dealing in the company's shares will begin on August 8.
Jardine Fleming Security Ltd is the sponsor and underwriter of the issue.

The net proceeds of about HK$605 million will be used to expand and upgrade the company's brewery plants in Shenzhen, to set up additional sales office in Guangdong province, with the balance for working capital.

Of the issue, 96.6 million shares will be offered for public subscription in Hong Kong, 218.4 million shares will be offered to Guangdong Investment's existing shareholders in the proportion of one Guangdong Brewery share for every eight Guangdong Investment shares held, and 35 million shares will be offered to employees.
The new issue of 350 million shares will represent about 28 percent of the company's enlarged share capital.
Guangdong Brewery forecast a profit after taxation and minority interest but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$90 miillion for the year ending December 31, 1997.
The company reported a profit of HK$62.27 million for the year ended in December 1996, up from HK$58.28 million in 1995 and HK$38.80 million in 1994.
Turnover was HK$446.70 million in 1996, up from HK$364.66 million in 1995 and HK$249.39 million in 1994.
Guangdong Brewery engages in the production, distribution, and sale of "Kingway" beer in south China's Guangdong province. It has two production plants in Shenzhen.
The company said Guangdong Investement will hold 72 percent of the firm following listing.
